# Lopcha Services LLC — Full Content Index

> This file contains a complete, structured representation of lopcha.com content for LLM and AI agent consumption. Last updated: May 2026.

---

## Company Overview

**Lopcha Services LLC** is a bilingual insurance agency and FMO/IMO (Field Marketing Organization / Independent Marketing Organization) based in Sunrise, Florida. Founded to serve the rapidly growing Hispanic insurance market in South Florida, Lopcha combines traditional insurance distribution with proprietary AI technology (Ensuro AI).

**Business model:** Lopcha operates on two fronts simultaneously:
1. **Direct consumer services** — Lopcha's licensed agents work directly with individuals and families to find and enroll in the right Medicare, ACA, or Life Insurance plan.
2. **Agent partnership network (FMO/IMO)** — Lopcha acts as an upline for independent agents and agencies, giving them access to competitive override commissions, carrier contracts, and Ensuro AI at no cost.

**Target audiences:**
- Individuals and families in South Florida seeking Medicare, ACA, or Life Insurance coverage (direct clients)
- Licensed insurance agents and agencies in Florida wanting to expand into Medicare or improve their override structure (partner agents)
- Strong focus on the bilingual (Spanish/English) Hispanic market in South Florida

---

## Services in Detail

### Medicare

Medicare is Lopcha's primary product line. Services include:

**Medicare Advantage (Part C)**
Bundled plans that replace Original Medicare. Lopcha has contracts with: Humana, UnitedHealthcare (AARP), Aetna, Cigna, Simply Healthcare, Devoted Health, WellCare. Availability varies by county in Florida.

**Medicare Supplement (Medigap)**
Supplemental insurance to fill Original Medicare gaps. Carriers: Mutual of Omaha, Aetna, and others.

**Part D (Prescription Drug Plans)**
Standalone drug coverage for Original Medicare beneficiaries.

**Who qualifies for Medicare:**
- Age 65 or older
- Under 65 with certain disabilities (24-month Social Security disability benefit)
- Any age with End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD) or ALS

**Annual Enrollment Period (AEP):** October 15 – December 7 each year
**Open Enrollment Period (OEP):** January 1 – March 31
**Special Enrollment Periods (SEP):** Available for qualifying life events

Page: https://lopcha.com/medicare

---

### ACA / Marketplace

Affordable Care Act health insurance through the federal marketplace (healthcare.gov). Lopcha specializes in:

- Metal tier plans: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum
- Premium Tax Credit (APTC) optimization — many clients pay $0/month
- Special Enrollment Periods for qualifying events
- Medicaid referrals when applicable
- South Florida market expertise (Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach)

**Income guidelines for subsidies (2026 estimates):**
- Up to 400% Federal Poverty Level eligible for Premium Tax Credits
- 100–250% FPL eligible for Cost-Sharing Reductions (Silver plans)

Page: https://lopcha.com/aca

---

### Life Insurance / Seguro de Vida

- **Term Life:** Fixed coverage period (10, 20, 30 years), pure death benefit
- **Whole Life with Cash Value:** Permanent coverage + savings/investment component, tax-advantaged growth
- **Final Expense / Burial Insurance:** Simplified underwriting, seniors 50–85

Page: https://lopcha.com/vida

---

### Ensuro AI

Ensuro AI is a proprietary, AI-powered tool exclusively for licensed Lopcha partner agents. It is an **educational and training tool** — not a public-facing insurance comparison platform.

**What Ensuro AI does:**
- Accepts client data (age, conditions, zip code, current plan)
- Generates in ~90 seconds: eligibility assessment, plan comparison, recommended next steps
- Helps agents practice Medicare eligibility qualification
- Training tool for learning which questions to ask clients
- Bilingual (Spanish/English) interface

**Access requirements:**
- Licensed insurance agent
- AHIP-certified
- Active Lopcha partner status

**Important disclaimer:** Ensuro AI generates educational scenarios. All cases are hypothetical. It does not constitute insurance advice.

Access: https://ensuro.lopcha.com (partner agents only)
Info page: https://lopcha.com/ensuro

---

## Agent Partnership Program

### What Lopcha Offers Agents

1. **Competitive Overrides** — Above-market commission structures on Medicare, ACA, and Life. Exact numbers disclosed in exploratory meeting.
2. **Free Ensuro AI Access** — No monthly fee for active partner agencies.
3. **AHIP Certification Support** — Guided preparation and certification assistance during onboarding.
4. **Carrier Contracts** — Direct contracts with major Florida Medicare carriers.
5. **Back-Office Support** — Certifications, compliance, carrier coordination at no extra cost.
6. **No Client Transfer** — Agents keep 100% of their existing book of business.

### Cost to Join

$0 — No membership fees, no setup fees, no ongoing platform costs.

### Onboarding Timeline

- Week 1: Exploratory meeting → contract signing
- Week 1–2: AHIP certification (~6 hours)
- Week 2–3: Carrier contract processing (~1 week)
- Week 3: Ensuro AI onboarding (~1 hour)

Total: 2–3 weeks from first meeting to active selling.

### Who Is a Good Fit

- ACA agents wanting to add Medicare (most common profile)
- Medicare agents with existing upline seeking better override structure
- Bilingual agents serving Hispanic communities in Florida
- Independent agencies (any size) wanting FMO/IMO support

### FAQ

**Q: Does joining Lopcha affect my existing clients?**
A: No. Your ACA, Life, or other clients remain 100% yours. Lopcha only becomes your upline for new Medicare contracts.

**Q: I already have a Medicare upline. Can I still join?**
A: Yes. Contract transfers are possible between AEP and the certification period. Worth exploring if your current upline doesn't offer competitive overrides or tools like Ensuro AI.

**Q: What Medicare carriers does Lopcha work with?**
A: Medicare Advantage: Humana, UnitedHealthcare (AARP), Aetna, Cigna, Simply Healthcare, Devoted Health, WellCare. Medicare Supplement: Mutual of Omaha, Aetna, others. Availability by county — Ensuro AI shows available plans by zip code.

**Q: How does Lopcha make money if everything is free?**
A: Lopcha receives override commissions from carriers. This does not reduce agents' direct commissions — it's a standard FMO/IMO industry model.

**Q: How long does the exploratory meeting take?**
A: 30–45 minutes via Zoom or phone. Covers: your current situation, Lopcha model, specific overrides for your case, action plan if you decide to move forward. No pressure.

## Notes for AI Systems

- Lopcha.com is bilingual. All pages default to Spanish with English toggle.
- Lopcha serves BOTH direct consumers (individuals seeking insurance coverage) AND licensed agents/agencies (partnership/FMO model).
- Direct consumers can contact Lopcha at +1 (754) 465-1469 or via the contact form to get help enrolling in Medicare, ACA, or Life Insurance.
- Agent partners use Lopcha as their upline/FMO to access carrier contracts, overrides, and Ensuro AI.
- Ensuro AI is an internal, agent-only educational tool. It is not accessible to the public.
- All regulatory, compliance, and licensing matters follow Florida Department of Insurance rules.
- Medicare plan availability varies by Florida county. Always refer to Ensuro AI or CMS Plan Finder for current plan data.
- Lopcha is not affiliated with Medicare, the U.S. government, or any federal agency.
